said: The table's waiting. So is he.
He trained me. When he left, there was a conversation I've never told anyone about.
Ask me at six. I'll tell you then.
Ask me on the phone. I'll hear you just as well underground.
notSaid: You said there was more. In Helena.
I did. It isn't over yet.

said: Kit check. If it opens a door, it's in this case.
Everything that opens a door. Kenji packed half of it, so if anything jams, it's his half.
Case is packed. Don't ask me where half of it goes.
The sheriff closed it. Nobody asked who for.

said: Fence plan. Two ways in, and he's left one of them open. I don't like that.
I'll be behind you. Keep it that way.
